timing: Operational visual-review sampling plan written during batch startup, not formal preregistration.
sampling: Inspect baseline first delivered current image for each task.

For each task and each A/B/C, compare earliest valid replicate to earliest valid baseline on common delivered PNGs. Choose first actual-action target difference ordered by actor step then baseline step. If none, retain initial same-action example and explicitly report no sampled difference.

For each task choose earliest within-actor pair with different canonical observed paths, actor order baseline/A/B/C then replicate order, and first actual action difference on common delivered PNG. If no eligible pair, report absent.
Privacy additionally inspect earliest observed basic and extended enabling actions if both exist, plus earliest C actual permission decision; deduplicate cases. Do not select by objective success.
framePolicy: Use delivered current PNG and next delivered PNG only when exists. Terminal audit image remains separate and never represented as next model input.
limits: At most16unique cases/32delivered PNG references; raw complete trials remain available.
interpretation: Observation, self-reported basis and inference separated. Do not infer unknown-term comprehension, intent, naturalness, hard trait violation or human fit from one action. No cases sorted by success.
